2.

This appeal is against the impugned award dated 27.07.2024 passed by the learned Motor Accident Claim Tribunal / Additional District Judge, Vikasnagar, Dehradun in M.A.C.P No.39/2021,
'Smt. Ritika Joshi, and others Vs. Shahzad and others'.
3.

sentences.text: By the impugned award the claim petition of the respondents /claimants was partly allowed thereby awarding a compensation of 1,00,53,680/- with interest @ 7% per annum.

4. Counsel for the appellant would submit that for the award of compensation in a motor accident under Section 166 of the M.V. Act, the Tribunal has to arrive at the finding that the accident took place due to rash driving and negligence of the driver of the offending vehicle; that, in paragraph no.15 to 18 of the impugned award there is no unequivocal finding by the Tribunal that accident took place due to rash driving and negligence of the driver of the H/7627.
5.

Counsel for the appellant would further submit that rather in paragraph no.19 of the impugned award, most surprisingly the Tribunal observed that the issue was framed whether the accident took place due to rash and negligent driving of the offending vehicle but the criminal case under Section 279 IPC is pending before the Criminal Court having jurisdiction, therefore, it is not correct to give any conclusion on this point at this stage.
6.

This Court finds itself unable to comprehend that if the rash and negligent driving of the offending vehicle is not proved on record, as issue no.1 and 2 framed by the Tribunal, then how can the liability to pay the compensation on the driver of the offending vehicle involved in the accident has strict liability or its owner has vicarious liability or on the Insurance Company as contractual liability be fixed.

In view of the above submissions, this Court is of the considered view that the matter needs deliberation.

9. Issue notice to the respondents through ordinary process and registered post acknowledgement due as well as by Email and WhatsApp, if available.
10.
Steps to be taken within four days.
11. Notice shall also be served through S.H.O. of the Police Station Vikasnagar Nagar, Dehradun.

Meanwhile, effect and operation of the impugned award dated 27.07.2024 passed by the learned Motor Accident Claim Tribunal /Additional District Judge, Vikasnagar, Dehradun in M.A.C.P.
No.39/2021, 'Smt. Ritika Joshi and others Vs. Shahzad and others' is stayed till the next date of listing.
